name: flare-poc
title: Cindra Flare PoC
author: cindra
description: Standalone proof-of-concept for Cindra's signature power mechanic: telegraphed solar flares (engine daylight curve + high surface solar multiplier, ~100x peak) and the disposal-deficit panel-damage rule, with a two-tier storage + dissipator sink web. Runs in isolation on its own scratch surface; touches no other planet. See planet_design.md sections 10, 12, 16.
